nodes.label: Roscommon Hedgerow-Bank-Ditch Boundary Prior
nodes.rationale: Source-backed regional guidance makes hedgerows, banks, ditches, remnant hedges, and stone-earthen banks the default for ordinary County Roscommon boundaries, reserving continuous stone walls for corroborated rocky, yard, gate, road, or local-landscape contexts.

nodes.label: Authentic Irish Dry-Stone Wall Visual Contract
nodes.rationale: Source-supported walls must be mortarless and irregular, using locally gathered mixed stones, gaps, chinks, uneven coping, vegetation, and broken silhouettes; uniform blocks, ashlar, brick courses, cobble chains, and gray bead walls fail.
